cases.q: if i switch on low power mode on the bv30 how much current does it actually pull sitting idle? its running pulse
cases.reference: In Low Power Mode the BV30's current consumption drops to approximately 1.2mA. Low Power Mode can only be used with the non-serial Parallel, Pulse and Binary protocols (so Pulse is fine) and is enabled via the configuration cards or Validator Manager; in this mode the front sensor is only checked every second, so note acceptance can be slightly delayed.

cases.q: how often am I supposed to swap the drive belts on these nv9usb+ units?
cases.reference: ITL recommends changing the NV9USB+ drive belts every 6-12 months or as required, depending on environmental factors. If dirt is building up or the belts show excessive use/wear, they should be swapped sooner.

cases.q: which version of validator manager should i be using for the nv9usb+, and will it run on my windows 10 laptop?
cases.reference: ITL recommends Validator Manager version 5.3 or higher for the NV9USB+ range. The listed system requirements are Windows 11 or later, .NET Framework 4.5 or later, Visual C++ redistributable runtimes, 256Mb RAM, 100Mb free disk, a connected active port and an externally powered USB hub; Windows 10 is not among the stated requirements.

cases.q: want to use the new moulded cashbox on our nv9 spectral units, what firmware/hardware do they need?
cases.reference: The moulded cashbox is only compatible with NV9 Spectral firmware 1.20 or higher and build revision 8 or higher (that build revision includes the sensor electronics and the PA04349 rear housing). Its cashbox presence sensor can be configured via the Validator Manager option 'NV9S Cashbox Detect' or via SSP commands.
pages: NV9 Spectral Range User Manual-v1.pdf p17

cases.q: what mdb version does the nv9 spectral do? our vending controller is a bit old
cases.reference: The NV9 Spectral supports MDB version 4.0 and later. An NV9S running MDB can use an IF5-type external interface (listed as PA05419 MDB adaptor, long version) to regulate the power supply and opto-isolate the communication lines.
pages: NV9 Spectral Range User Manual-v1.pdf p55

cases.q: last reject code came back 0x13 on the nv200 spectral, what's that mean
cases.reference: Reject code 0x13 (19) is ESCROW TIMEOUT: a note held in escrow was rejected because the host did not communicate within the time-out period. The default timeout is the same as the poll timeout, i.e. 10 seconds.
pages: NV200 Spectral SSP Manual v.1.pdf p47

cases.q: what grease do i put on the coin feeder path and how often
cases.reference: After cleaning the Coin Feeder the coated surface must be renewed with silicone lubricant; the recommended and tested product is Ambersil AMS4 Silicone Grease. This is required every 50,000 coins (cycles), and it should only be applied in the hatched areas shown, without disassembling the device.
pages: SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf p81
SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf p77

cases.q: integrating a mycheckr over usb with our own software. whats the base url for the local api and how does auth work
cases.reference: Over RNDIS (USB) the base URL is https://192.168.137.8:44345 with base path api/v1_0. You authenticate by POSTing form-encoded grant_type=password, username and password to {BASE_URL}/token; the returned bearer token is valid for 3600 seconds and must be sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on every call, requesting a fresh one whenever a call returns 401. The device uses a self-signed HTTPS certificate that the host client must be configured to trust.

cases.q: what screws do i need to fix the mycheckr to the counter
cases.reference: The MyCheckr should be securely mounted to a flat surface using 4mm screws through the 4 mounting holes provided, or alternatively with a 1/4" 20 thread screw in the bottom centre of the device.

cases.q: fresh out the box what age is the mini set to check against, and how far away does it look
cases.reference: Out of the box the MyCheckr Mini has an Age Threshold of 25 and a detection Distance setting of 1.0 m. Other defaults: Age only mode, spoof detection off, spoof terminate and spoof indicator LED disabled, camera level on, API credentials apiuser/apipassword.

cases.q: we mounted the mini sideways and the picture is rotated, can i fix that in software?
cases.reference: Yes - on the Camera Configuration & Live View page in IMS 2.0 the Camera Rotation setting rotates the camera image to match the physical orientation of the device for non-standard mounting; the available options are 0°, 90°, 180° and 270°. The manual recommends verifying rotation matches the final mounting orientation before commissioning.

cases.q: found the hub in the app but its asking for a login, what's the default?
cases.reference: The default MyConnect Hub app login is Username: user1, Password: password1. Credentials can be changed from within the app's settings, and 'Remember me' saves them for future sessions. (These are different from the MyCheckr API credentials apiuser/apipassword used when registering a device.)
pages: CS-MyConnect Quick Start Guide – Installer Edition-240226-141456.pdf p7

cases.q: what size micro sd can i stick in the nv9 spectral? got some 64gb ones lying around
cases.reference: The microSD card must be MBR-partitioned and FAT32-formatted, minimum 4 GB and speed class 4; the stated maximum is 32 GB and class 10, but the manual notes a larger capacity should not be an issue provided the card is formatted FAT32/MBR. Recommended cards are SanDisk Ultra microSDHC 32 GB and SanDisk High Endurance microSDHC 32GB.
pages: NV9 Spectral Range User Manual-v1.pdf p19

cases.q: how much current does it draw running once the note float is on (nv11+)? sizing a psu
cases.reference: For the NV11+ (NV9USB+ with Note Float) the maximum supply currents are 0.35A standby, 3.0A running and 3.5A peak, versus 0.2A / 1.0A / 1.5A for the NV9USB+ alone. Both need a stable 12V DC supply (10.8-13.2V DC); the suggested PSU is a TDK Lambda SWS50-12 (+12V DC / 4.3A).

cases.q: widest note the nv200 spectral can take? and does that change if we fit the payout
cases.reference: Media into the NV200 Spectral can be 56-85mm wide and 110-170mm long. With the optional Spectral Payout module, notes routed to the payout must be 56-82mm wide (length still 110-170mm).

cases.q: using the safe interface on nv200 spectral and it seems to slow down taking notes when its busy - whats the actual delay rule?
cases.reference: With the Safe Interface module there is a maximum duty cycle based on notes inserted in the previous 45 minutes: 0-250 notes adds no delay, rising gradually to 1 second between inserts at 400 notes and to 1.5 seconds at 500+ notes. That delay is then scaled by the count over the previous 5 minutes: 50+ notes = 1x the delay, 25-50 notes = 0.5x, 0 notes = zero delay.

cases.q: how many 1 cent coins can sit in the hopper before it complains
cases.reference: Coins under 18mm need special handling: for EUR 0.01, the number in the hopper during normal operation should not exceed 25% of all coins, or 20 coins if there are no other coins in the device - whichever is greater. If exceeded, the SCS automatically tries to dump the excess to the cashbox, and the host should reduce them quickly using the Coin Level Control commands.
pages: SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf p64
SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf p65

cases.q: worst case current on the mycheckr at 24v if we've got stuff plugged into both usb-a ports?
cases.reference: At Max Load (Max Operating with Ethernet, Wi-Fi, OSDP, USB-B streaming, plus both USB Type-A ports drawing 0.5A each) the MyCheckr draws 560mA RMS and 665mA peak at 24VDC input. At 12VDC the same load is 1.10A RMS and 1.35A peak.

cases.q: bv30 bezel keeps flashing 4 red then 1 blue, what's wrong
cases.reference: 4 red / 1 blue flashes means PSU Voltage too Low. Check the power supply meets the Power Requirements: 10.8-13.2V DC (12V nominal) with a stable 12VDC / 1.50A capability, accounting for any other peripherals on the same supply.

cases.q: validator manager wont see my nv9usb+, someone said it needs to be in ssp. how do i flip it over?
cases.reference: Double-click the red configuration button to check the current interface (1 bezel flash = SSP). If it is not SSP, press and hold the red button until the bezel light illuminates, then release; the unit flickers, resets and starts up in SSP. Validator Manager only detects the validator in SSP and also needs the correct drivers installed (this toggle is not available on UK1 Special Firmware).

cases.q: note stuck in the payout module on our nv200 spectral, how do i get it out
cases.reference: First let the device run its automatic jam recovery without interrupting it; if that fails it reports a Jammed event. Then, with power removed, take the NV200 Spectral head off and slide the Spectral Payout module upwards off the chassis. Open the top door (slide the red latch forward, pinch the raised edge and lift), then press the red latch inside to spring open the second door, remove the notes, re-tension the tapes with the supplied hex key if needed, and afterwards run an Empty (0x3F) from Validator Manager's Commands tab.

cases.q: red light on the coin system is flashing 7 times over and over
cases.reference: 7 red flashes means Dataset/Unit type mismatch. Re-download the SCS firmware; if the fault persists, return the unit to ITL for service.
pages: SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf p85

cases.q: status bar in IMS keeps saying Spoof 3 on the mini and no age comes back
cases.reference: Spoof 3 means poor or uneven lighting. Install the device in an evenly lit area and avoid strong shadows.

cases.q: tapped search for hub on the tablet and nothing shows up
cases.reference: Make sure the network allows multicast/device discovery and that the Android tablet is on the same network/VLAN as the hub. If it still doesn't appear, find the hub's IP (via IMS Local or the router's network manager) and enter it manually in the app via 'Please Select a Hub'; contact your network administrator if devices remain hidden.
pages: CS-MyConnect Quick Start Guide – Installer Edition-240226-141456.pdf p7

cases.q: for mdb can i run the bv30 through an IF5 and the MDB adapter together?
cases.reference: No. An IF5 cannot be used with the MDB Adapter. A BV30 running MDB must use either an IF5 (PA02061) or the MDB Adapter (PA02344), not both.

cases.q: can the nv11 spectral run off our 24v rail like the nv9s does?
cases.reference: No. The NV11 Spectral operates exclusively at 12 V DC (the NV9 Spectral itself accepts 12 or 24 V).
pages: NV9 Spectral Range User Manual-v1.pdf p40

cases.q: can i put the mini on our wifi through IMS like the normal mycheckr?
cases.reference: No. Unlike the standard MyCheckr, the MyCheckr Mini does not support Ethernet or Wi-Fi configuration through IMS; those sections are disabled/shown for information only, and the Mini communicates through USB.

cases.q: our host talks cctalk - if we add the spectral payout do we have to reprogram the nv200 spectral to cc2?
cases.reference: No reprogramming is needed. When programmed to ccTalk, the NV200 Spectral recognises a connected payout module and automatically supports the extra recycling commands without switching to CC2; for legacy support the protocol can still be locked to CC2 if required.

cases.q: does the bv30 read barcode tickets? want to use it for redemption vouchers
cases.reference: The BV30 manual does not mention barcode or ticket (TITO) reading at all, so the bot should say it can't confirm from the documentation and suggest contacting ITL support, rather than answering yes or no.

cases.q: does the myconnect hub have a battery backup if the mains drops out?
cases.reference: The MyConnect documentation does not mention any battery, UPS or backup power for the hub; the bot should say it isn't documented rather than answering yes or no.

cases.q: can the smart coin system be set up to take our own arcade tokens as well as coins?
cases.reference: Token acceptance is not mentioned in the SMART Coin System manual (it only states coin size limits and that different hardware types are needed per currency, with details from support). The bot should say it cannot confirm from the manual and point to ITL support, not say yes or no.

cases.q: whats the IP rating on the mycheckr, can it go outside by a door?
cases.reference: The MyCheckr manual gives no IP/ingress rating and says nothing about outdoor installation (it only lists operating temperature +5 to +50°C and 5-95% non-condensing humidity). The bot should say the rating isn't documented rather than claim it is or isn't outdoor-rated.

cases.q: on paper which is more reliable, the bv30 or the nv9usb+?
cases.reference: The BV30 has a stated MCBF of 100,000 cycles, while the NV9USB+ has an MCBF of 200,000 cycles (MCBI 100,000). Note the NV9USB+ figures halve when a recycler is added (NV11+: MCBF 100,000 / MCBI 50,000).

cases.q: swapping our nv9usb+ for nv9 spectral - we take some short notes about 100mm long, will they still go through?
cases.reference: The NV9USB+ accepts notes 90-170mm long (62-82mm wide), so 100mm notes are within its range. The NV9 Spectral's minimum note length is 115mm (max 167mm, width 60-82mm), so a 100mm note is below the NV9 Spectral's specification.
pages: NV9 Spectral Range User Manual-v1.pdf p28

cases.q: what power do the mycheckr and the mycheckr mini each need? planning the wiring for a site with both
cases.reference: The MyCheckr takes 12-24VDC nominal (10.8VDC min to 26.4VDC max) on its power connector. The MyCheckr Mini runs on 5VDC (4.75-5.25V) supplied through its pre-attached USB-A cable, and it only operates using a USB 3.0 port when accessed from a host machine.

cases.q: how does the sd card update differ between the nv200 spectral and the smart coin system? techs keep mixing them up
cases.reference: NV200 Spectral: FAT32/MBR card, create a lowercase folder named nv200hs containing the dataset, insert into the powered and booted unit, wait for the bezel to go solid green, remove the card and it reboots in about 10 seconds. SMART Coin System: copy the dataset file renamed as update.cf1 onto the card; power state doesn't matter; LEDs alternate green/red during the update, then the unit resets and runs its motors (1-3 minutes, typically 90 seconds) before the card can be removed - and on a Twin, primary and secondary hoppers are updated separately.
pages: SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf p62
SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf p63

cases.turn1: how do i put the bv30 into programming mode?
cases.q: ok its in ssp now. how do i actually load the new file on?
cases.reference: Open Validator Manager and click detect devices (if it doesn't connect, check drivers and that the unit is in SSP). On the Program tab click open file, browse to the file and click OK, then hit 'Program Device' - the bezel flashes while updating. Don't interrupt it (it cannot be halted and interruption can leave the unit non-functional); when finished the unit restarts and a 'Device Programming Complete' pop-up appears.

cases.turn1: can i power the nv9 spectral from 24v instead of 12v?
cases.q: and what's the peak current at that voltage?
cases.reference: At 24 V the NV9 Spectral's peak current is 2 A (running 1.5 A, standby 0.13 A). The 24 V supply range is 21.6-26.4 V DC.
pages: NV9 Spectral Range User Manual-v1.pdf p26

cases.turn1: how do i switch the smart coin system from cc2 to ssp?
cases.q: how can i tell which one its on right now?
cases.reference: With the unit powered on, give the button two short presses (double tap); the red LED flashes once (1) for SSP or twice for CC2. This function requires firmware 1.32 or later.
pages: SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf p112

cases.turn1: how do i wire a door strike into the myconnect hub relay?
cases.q: what should i set the relay time to?
cases.reference: Set the GPIO Duration to 1 second in the Hub settings - this is the recommended/default value, and the manual warns that setting the relay to anything other than 1 second can cause adverse effects on the relay.
pages: CS-MyConnect Quick Start Guide – Installer Edition-240226-141456.pdf p10

cases.q: whats the max note length on the NV12USB+?
cases.reference: There is no NV12USB+ in the documentation; the bot should say it has no information on that model (and may offer NV9USB+/NV11+ figures) rather than inventing specs.

cases.q: whats the euro to pound exchange rate today? need to price the machine
cases.reference: Off-topic: exchange rates are not covered by the product documentation; the bot should decline.

cases.q: whats the max current it draws?
cases.reference: Underspecified: every product has different current figures (and some depend on 12V vs 24V or modules fitted); the bot should ask which product.

cases.q: how do i clear a jam
cases.reference: Underspecified: jam-clearing steps differ between the note validators (BV30, NV9USB+, NV9 Spectral, NV200 Spectral and its modules) and the SMART Coin System feeder/hopper; the bot should ask which product.
